definitions.explanation: Not achieving a desired outcome; making an error or mistake in an attempt.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{失敗|しっぱい}しました。
{失敗|しっぱい}は{成功|せいこう}のもとです。
examples.english: Failure is the mother of success.

examples.japanese: また{失敗|しっぱい}してしまった。

notes:
{失敗|しっぱい} is the opposite of {成功|せいこう} (success).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {失敗|しっぱい}する: to fail
- {失敗|しっぱい}に{終|お}わる: to end in failure
- 〜に{失敗|しっぱい}する: to fail at ~

RELATED TERMS:
- {成功|せいこう}: success
- {間違|まちが}い: mistake, error
- ミス: mistake (loanword)
- {落|お}ちる: to fail (an exam)

PROVERB: {失敗|しっぱい}は{成功|せいこう}のもと - Failure leads to success (equivalent to 'learn from your mistakes')
